description:
Animated promotional video bundled with the release of idol unit Liella's first single, Hajimari wa Kimi no Sora.

Note: The BD release of this single features a full animated version of the idol unit's song Hajimari wa Kimi no Sora, and includes short animated scenes between the members of the unit. This full version was later uploaded a year after its release onto the LoveLive! official YouTube channel on April 7, 2022.
